Farming

At our core: farming at scale

Farming is the heart of Sycamore Agritech. Our farms in Malawi grow three main crops: wheat, grown under irrigation through the cool dry season; sorghum; and maize, grown for seed production. Our fields are equipped with centre-pivot and hose-reel irrigation, with water applied according to crop growth stage.

Our team manages the whole field cycle, from land preparation and planting to irrigation, fertilisation, crop protection and timely harvest. Key operations are done with our own machinery, helping to keep yield and quality consistent every season.

  • Centre-pivot irrigation

    Large pivots rotate around a central point, watering whole fields evenly while saving water and labour.

  • Careful crop management

    Fertiliser and crop protection timed to each growth stage, with regular field checks to catch problems early.

  • Mechanised field work

    From ripping and ploughing to precision planting and spraying, the key field operations are done with our own machinery.

  • Timely harvest & storage

    Crops are harvested at maturity, then cleaned, bagged and stored in dry, hygienic conditions.

Malawi's farming calendar

Malawi has two main cropping seasons: rain-fed crops, mainly maize, in the rainy season, and irrigated winter crops such as wheat in the cool dry season. Land must be prepared before each planting, so that is when demand for machinery peaks.

Irrigation

Water makes harvests reliable

Malawi's rain falls mainly in one season, so dry-season farming depends on irrigation. Our fields use two types of sprinkler irrigation.

Centre-pivot irrigation

A multi-span machine turns slowly around a central point, watering a large circular area evenly. It is well suited to our broad wheat fields.

Hose-reel irrigator

As the hose winds back onto the reel, it pulls the sprinkler cart across the field, one strip at a time. The machine moves easily between fields for supplementary irrigation and is also available for hire.

Our crops

Wheat, sorghum and seed maize

These three crops are the mainstay of our farms.

Wheat

Grown under irrigation for flour milling and food processing. Malawi imports almost all of its wheat, so growing it locally helps reduce reliance on imports.

  • Flour mills
  • Food processing

Sorghum

A hardy, drought-tolerant cereal used for brewing, food processing and animal feed, supplied to each customer's specification.

Seed maize

Grown to seed-production standards to protect seed purity and quality: isolated fields, timely detasselling, removal of off-type plants (roguing), and separate harvesting and storage.

Machinery hire

Professional farm machinery, when you need it

Our own fleet of farm machinery is available for hire, covering land preparation, planting, spraying, harvesting and irrigation. The equipment is well maintained and can come with an experienced operator, so farms, estates and cooperatives can get the work done on time.

See the fleet and hire details Book machinery

What we can do

  • Land preparation

    Disc ploughing, plus subsoiling to break up compacted layers.

  • Precision planting

    Multi-row precision planting for even seed and row spacing.

  • Crop spraying

    Tractor-mounted boom sprayers for weed, pest and disease control.

  • Combine harvesting

    A self-propelled combine that harvests and threshes in one pass.

  • Mobile irrigation

    A hose-reel irrigator that moves between fields for supplementary watering.

  • Ditching & earthworks

    A crawler excavator for digging ditches, clearing obstacles and other farm infrastructure work.

About us

Rooted in Malawi, built to last

Sycamore Agritech Limited is based in Lilongwe, Malawi's capital, and works across large-scale farming, agricultural machinery hire, and wheat and sorghum supply. The sycamore is a broad, deep-rooted tree, and that is how we want to grow: rooted in the land, steady, and building long-term partnerships with our customers.

“Plant a sycamore, and the phoenix will come.”

An old Chinese saying: build something worthwhile, and good partners will follow.
